DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はお申し込みでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は家族と読む資料を持ち帰りたいです。申込みはまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本日は申込みでなく資料持ち帰りが目的だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today I'd like to take materials home to read with my family. I haven't decided to apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say today's purpose is taking materials home, not applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 資料の案内と、個別の相談受付は別に行えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can provide materials and accept individual consultation requests separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず一般の資料を希望します。自分が対象になるかも、家族と条件を見てから相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一般資料から条件を読む段階だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like general materials first. I'll review the conditions with my family before asking whether I qualify too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you are at the stage of reading conditions in general materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。制度名はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Do you know the programme name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この案内にある住まいの支援です。似た名前の子どもの支援ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象制度を似た名称の別制度と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The housing support in this notice. Not the similarly named child support.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the intended programme from another similarly named one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 該当する資料をご案内します。資料を受け取っただけで、申請や予約は成立しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll provide the relevant materials. Receiving them alone does not constitute an application or appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家で読んで、分からない条件を印で残します。家族の意見も聞いてから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族と読み不明条件を整理すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll read at home and mark conditions I don't understand. I'll hear my family's views before consulting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to read with your family and organize unclear conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談の受付方法も資料と一緒にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you consultation reception instructions with the materials too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は資料と相談方法だけ受け取り、申請済みとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料受領と申請・予約成立を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Today I'll receive only materials and consultation instructions, and won't say I've applied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish receiving materials from an application or appointment being established. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。住まいの支援の資料と相談案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here are the housing support materials and consultation guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の受付時刻はご確認になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you checked the test reception time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察が十時なので十時に来ました。検査の時刻は見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察時刻だけを見て来院したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My consultation is at ten, so I came at ten. I hadn't looked at the test time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you came after checking only the consultation time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 票には検査受付が先に書かれています。現在の対応は担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The slip lists test reception earlier. I'll check with the person in charge how to handle it now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。早い受付と診察の時刻が二つあるのですね。まだ検査は受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先の検査受付を見落とし未検査だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. There are two times: earlier reception and the consultation. I haven't had the test yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you overlooked earlier test reception and haven't been tested. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。予定どおり進められるとは限らないので、状況をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. It may not proceed as scheduled, so we'll explain the situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分で先に診察室へ行かず、検査の担当者へ来た時刻を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で診察へ進まず到着時刻を担当者に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't go to the consultation room myself; I'll tell the test staff my arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not proceed to consultation yourself; give staff your arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では担当者が順番と本日の対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this situation the person in charge will check the order and what can be done today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。仕事へ戻る予定もあるので、待ち時間が分かる範囲で知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事の予定から待ち時間の見通しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I also plan to return to work, so I'd like an estimate of the wait as far as known.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the wait because of your work plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲をご説明します。終了時刻の保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain what we can confirm. We cannot guarantee a finish time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。会社には診察だけの時刻で戻れるとは約束せず、対応の説明を聞いて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了を確約せず案内後に会社へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't promise work I can return based on the consultation time alone. I'll hear the arrangements and contact them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not promise a finish; contact work after the guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。検査受付を見落とした状況として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hand this over as a case where earlier test reception was overlooked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相手の連絡先について分かることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you know anything about the other person's contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このメモに住所があります。ただ、二年前にもらったので、今も住んでいるか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参住所が二年前の情報だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This note has an address. But I received it two years ago, so I don't know whether they still live there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the address you brought is two-year-old information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在確認できた住所ではなく、過去に受け取った情報なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it's information received in the past, not a currently verified address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私が最近その家へ行ったわけではありません。古い住所を現在の住所と書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現住確認しておらず現在住所として記録しないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I haven't recently visited that home. Please don't record the old address as their current one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say residence is unverified and ask not to record it as current. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入手した時期と方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell me when and how you obtained it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二年前に本人から名刺をもらいました。引っ越したと聞いたことはありますが、転居先は知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料入手と転居の伝聞の出所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They gave me a business card two years ago. I've heard they moved, but don't know the new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the source of the document and the hearsay about moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。古い資料と、聞いた転居の話を分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll record the old document separately from what you heard about the move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。確認のため自分で近所を探し回る前に、必要な情報を担当者へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 独自探索より担当者への情報相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. Before searching the neighbourhood myself, I'd like to ask the person in charge what information is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prefer consulting staff about information to an independent search. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、相談の担当者へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I'll connect you to the consultation staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名刺は元のまま見せます。分からない現在地を、地図から推測して足しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元資料を提示し現住所を推測で補わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the business card unchanged. I won't guess their unknown current location from a map and add it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the original document and do not supplement the current address by guesswork. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料の時点と未確認の範囲を担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass on the document's date and what remains unverified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り先の国を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which country are you sending it to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベトナムです。家族の住所を母語で書きましたが、国名もこのままで分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送り先国と母語で書いた宛名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Vietnam. I wrote my family's address in my native language. Is the country name understandable as it is too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the destination country and the address written in your language. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 国際発送の宛名の書き方を担当者が確認します。国名が明確か見てご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The international shipping staff will check how the address is written, including whether the country is clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。住所の細かい部分を、自分で知らない英語へ訳して別の場所にしないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所を自己翻訳で変えず表示方法の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. I don't want to translate address details into English I don't know and accidentally make it a different place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to display it without altering the address through your own translation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正式な住所は保ち、必要な表示を確認しましょう。受取人の名前はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep the official address and check the required markings. Which is the recipient's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この行です。住所の行と名前の行が近いので、区切り方も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人名と住所の行の区切りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: This line. The name and address lines are close, so I'd like to check how to separate them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the separation of the recipient-name and address lines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご案内する様式に合わせて読みやすく書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can write it legibly using the format we show you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。必要なら新しい封筒に書きます。住所の意味を変えず、国名と宛名の位置を整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式住所を保持し国名と配置を整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll use a new envelope if needed. I'll arrange the country and address placement without changing the address's meaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Preserve the official address and arrange the country name and layout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身についても国際発送の確認があります。内容を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The contents also need international shipping checks. What is inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族への手紙だけです。国名、宛名の配置、中身を確認してから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名と中身の確認後に国際発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only a letter to family. I'll check the country, address layout and contents before sending internationally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send internationally after checking the address and contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。国際郵便の担当者へ、宛名と内容の確認を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hand address and contents checking over to international mail staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどの口座への入金をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which account do you want to deposit into today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から預かった現金です。とりあえず自分の口座に入れようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 預かり現金を自分の口座へ入れたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is cash entrusted to me by family. I thought I'd put it into my own account for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about depositing entrusted cash in your account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族は入金先や用途を指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your family specify the account or purpose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母の家賃に使うように言われましたが、自分の口座へ入れてよいかは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の用途指定と口座指定の未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was told to use it for my mother's rent, but haven't asked whether I may put it in my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the family specified the purpose but the account is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行でできる手続きと、ご家族からの依頼内容は分けて確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to distinguish what the bank can do from the request your family made.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分のお金と混ぜる前に、母へ入金先と支払い方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族の意思を確認するまで混ぜないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Before mixing it with my money, I'll check the deposit destination and payment method with my mother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not mix it until you confirm the family's wishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。現金はご本人がそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please keep the cash yourself as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。金額と預かった目的を記録し、銀行へ預けたことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金を保持し預かり目的と額を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll record the amount and purpose of holding it, and won't treat it as deposited at the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the cash and record the purpose and amount entrusted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に、必要な手続きと本人確認をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After confirmation we can explain the required procedure and identity verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。母の依頼を確認してから相談し、今日は自分の口座へ入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定確認前は本人の口座へ入金しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll consult after checking my mother's request, and won't put it in my account today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to deposit in your account before confirming instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日の入金は進めず、確認後のご相談をお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We won't proceed with a deposit today and will await your consultation after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお探しの商品がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎週買うお茶が棚にありません。売り切れなら別の物にしようと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の空きから売り切れと判断したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The tea I buy every week isn't on the shelf. If sold out, I thought I'd choose something else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you concluded it was sold out from the empty shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 季節の売場へ移した物もあります。商品名や容器は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some items have moved to the seasonal area. Do you know the name or container?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真の物です。いつもの棚が空だったので、在庫がないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真で探す商品を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one in this photo. The usual shelf was empty, so I thought it was out of stock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the product using a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認すると、今回は入口の売場へ移っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked; this time it has moved to the display at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。棚の場所だけで売り切れと決めず、移った売場を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動先を見て在庫を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I won't decide it's sold out based on shelf location alone; I'll look at the new display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to check the stock at the new location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらにございます。以前と同じサイズかもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here it is. Check whether it's the same size as before too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真は五百ミリですが、ここにあるのは一リットルですね。持ち歩くので小さい方を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同銘柄でも必要サイズが違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The photo is 500 millilitres, but this is one litre. I'll carry it with me, so I want the small size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the same brand can still be the wrong size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さいサイズの在庫は別に確認します。大きい物の在庫だけでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check small-size stock separately. Stock of the large size alone doesn't tell us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。銘柄の所在と、小さいサイズの在庫を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品所在と希望サイズの在庫を区別して依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I'll distinguish the brand's location from stock of the small size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request brand location and desired-size stock separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。五百ミリの在庫を担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check 500-millilitre stock with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水道の使い方についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about using the tap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昼食の容器を洗いたいです。水が出る所なら使ってよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水道で食器を洗えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to wash my lunch container. I thought I could use anywhere water comes out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can wash dishes at the tap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では手洗い用の場所で、食器洗いには使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation this is for handwashing, not for washing dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用途が違うんですね。食べ残しを流したり、洗剤を使ったりはまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用途の違いを理解し未使用の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The purpose differs. I haven't poured leftovers down or used detergent yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the different purpose and say you haven't used it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま容器を持ち帰ってください。水道の周囲にも残さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Take the container home as it is. Don't leave it around the tap either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ふた付きの袋に入れて持ち帰ります。手を洗う利用だけならできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち帰りを決め手洗い利用の可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put it in a bag with a closure and take it home. May I use this only to wash my hands?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to take it home and check handwashing is permitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、手洗いとしてご利用ください。案内にも従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Use it for handwashing and follow the signs too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。容器を先にしまい、食べ残しが水道へ落ちないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容器をしまい食べ残しの流入を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll put the container away first so leftovers won't fall into the water area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put away the container and prevent leftovers entering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。持ち帰り用のごみもご自身で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please. Look after the rubbish you'll take home yourself too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。手洗いと食器洗いを分け、容器とごみは家まで持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手洗いだけ利用し容器とごみを持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll distinguish handwashing from dishwashing and take the container and rubbish all the way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use it only for handwashing and take the container and rubbish home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。手洗いとして使ったあとは、次の方へお譲りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. After handwashing, please give way to the next person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の通過でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble passing the ticket gate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ベビーカーの幅が合いません。子どもを抱いて畳もうと思いますが、荷物も多いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカーが通れず抱っこと荷物運びが難しいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The stroller is too wide. I thought I'd hold my child and fold it, but I have lots of luggage too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the stroller won't fit and holding the child plus luggage is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に一人で全てを持つ前に、使える通路を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before trying to hold everything alone, let's check which passage you can use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。車輪を引っ張って押し込まず、このまま止めて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 押し込まず停止して通路確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. I won't pull the wheels and force it through; I'll stop here and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stop without forcing it and ask for a passage check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では広い改札を係員が案内します。きっぷはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation staff will show you a wide gate. Do you have your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友人が通った後なので、友人にはその先で待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券を示し先に通過した友人の待機を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My friend already went through, so I'll have them wait just beyond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the ticket and say your friend who passed ahead will wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。通過後にどの場所で合流するかも決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Decide where you'll meet after passing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広い改札の先の壁側です。友人が戻って無理に狭い通路へ入らないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合流場所を指定し友人の逆戻りを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: By the wall beyond the wide gate. I'll tell my friend not to come back and force into the narrow passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the meeting place and avoid your friend returning backwards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。係員がきっぷと通路を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Staff will check the ticket and passage before guiding you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもと荷物を持ち上げる前に広い通路の案内を受け、そこで合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無理に畳まず係員案内で通過すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Before lifting my child and bags, I'll get guidance to the wide passage and meet there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to force folding, but pass with staff guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。そのままお待ちください。広い改札へ係員がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Wait as you are. Staff will take you to the wide gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約番号をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your consultation appointment number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありません。知人が水曜日に通訳してくれるので、水曜日の相談も決まったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人の通訳予定を窓口予約と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. An acquaintance will interpret on Wednesday, so I thought the consultation on Wednesday was booked too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you mistook the acquaintance's interpreting arrangement for an office appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 知人との予定と、窓口の相談予約は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your arrangement with the acquaintance and an office consultation appointment are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。窓口へはまだ連絡していません。水曜日に相談できるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口未連絡を認め希望日の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I haven't contacted the office yet. I'd like to check whether I can consult on Wednesday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge no contact and ask about the desired day's availability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談内容と担当窓口を先に確認します。何についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: First we'll check the topic and responsible desk. What is it about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住まいの書類です。知人は同行できますが、窓口が用意する通訳ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談内容と通訳が知人同行であることを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Housing documents. My acquaintance can accompany me, but isn't an interpreter arranged by the office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the topic and clarify interpretation is by your accompanying acquaintance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。知人同行の扱いと予約方法を担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll check how their attendance is handled and how to book with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。知人が来られるから必ず同じ日に相談できるとは約束せず、返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行可能日だけで窓口対応を確約しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I won't promise the consultation can definitely happen that day just because they can come; I'll wait for the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not promise office availability based only on your companion's day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。希望日が合わなければ、相談と同行の予定を調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If the requested day doesn't work, adjust both consultation and accompaniment plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。窓口の可能な日時を聞いてから知人に相談し、両方が合う日を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口と知人の両方の予定を確認して日を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll hear the office's available dates and times, then ask my acquaintance and choose a day that fits both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check both the office's and acquaintance's schedules before choosing a day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談予約と知人同行の確認として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hand this over for checking consultation booking and accompaniment by your acquaintance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は面会のご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to visit someone today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父の退院の迎えです。会いに来たので、面会の列に並びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 面会でなく父の退院迎えだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm here to pick up my father after discharge. I came to see him, so I joined the visiting queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you're picking up your father after discharge, not visiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 退院のお迎えですね。退院準備が完了したと連絡を受けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: For discharge pickup, then. Have you been told discharge preparations are complete?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日退院予定とは聞きましたが、今すぐ帰れるとは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 退院予定日は知るが準備完了は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard he was scheduled for discharge today, but not that he could leave right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you know the planned discharge day but completion is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予定日と準備完了は別です。病棟の担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The planned day and completed preparations are separate. I'll check with the ward staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私が先に病室へ入り、父を連れ出すのでなく、迎えの手順を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勝手に連れ出さず迎えの手順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I want the pickup procedure, rather than going into his room and taking him out myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the pickup procedure instead of taking him out on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 病棟へお名前と続柄を伝えて確認します。お車はどちらにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll give the ward your name and relationship and check. Where is your car?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 夫が駐車場で待っています。玄関へ車を回す時刻も、準備が整ってから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車の待機状況を示し移動時刻を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My husband is waiting in the car park. I want to decide when to bring the car to the entrance only once preparations are ready too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the car's waiting situation and check when to move it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで待ち、担当者の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Wait here for guidance from the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。夫にはまだ玄関へ来てもらわず、退院準備と迎えの場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 準備と迎え場所の案内まで車も待機させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't ask my husband to come to the entrance yet; I'll confirm preparations and the pickup location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the car waiting until guidance on preparations and pickup location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。退院のお迎えとして病棟担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I'll hand this over to ward staff as a discharge pickup.
